meta.title: Book your shade
meta.description: Book a table at Zill in Al-Balad, Jeddah, or Wadi Hanifah, Riyadh — choose the house, the day, the hour and the corner of the courtyard.

title: Book your shade
intro: Tables open {n} days ahead, and we hold yours for a few minutes while you finish.

party.moreBody: For larger parties we set up a private room or the long table. Tell us what you have in mind.
party.kids: Children are counted as guests; high chairs are free.

time.none: Nothing is free that day for this many guests.
time.noneHint: Try another day, fewer guests — or join the waitlist and we will write if a table opens.
time.error: We could not check the tables. Please try again.
time.zoneNote: Times are in the house’s local time.

hold.expired: The hold has ended. Please choose the time again.
hold.taken: That table was just taken. Please choose another time.

areas.courtyardHint: Under the sky and the vine.
areas.liwanHint: The cool, covered gallery around the courtyard.
areas.roofHint: Open to the sky after sunset.
areas.anyHint: We will seat you wherever the light is best.

details.notesHint: A high chair, a step-free table, a surprise…
details.dietaryHint: We pass these to the kitchen with your booking.
details.privacy: We use your details only for this booking.

deposit.title: A deposit of {amount}
deposit.body: For parties of {n} or more we take {perGuest} per guest to hold the table. It comes off your bill, and is refunded in full if you cancel at least {hours} ahead.
deposit.later: If the payment is not completed within {minutes} minutes, the table is released.

summary.title: Your booking
summary.empty: Choose a house, a day and a time — your booking takes shape here.

waitlist.title: Join the waitlist
waitlist.body: Leave your details and how flexible you are. If a table opens, we write straight away — first come, first served.
waitlist.done: You are on the waitlist for {date}. We will write to {email} if a table opens.
waitlist.open: Join the waitlist for this day

confirmed.title: Your shade is booked
confirmed.pending: Your table is held while the deposit completes
confirmed.body: A confirmation is on its way to {email}. Show this page or the booking number when you arrive.
confirmed.policy: You can change or cancel online until {hours} before your booking. After that, please call the house.
confirmed.lapsed: The deposit was not completed in time, so the table was released. Anything you paid is being refunded in full.

manage.title: Your booking
manage.invalid: This link is not valid. Use the link in your confirmation email, or call the house.
manage.change: Change the day, time or guests
manage.changeHint: Pick a new time below. Your current table stays yours until the new one is confirmed.
manage.saved: Your booking has been moved. A new confirmation is on its way.
manage.cancelBody: Your table will be released for someone else.
manage.cancelled: Your booking is cancelled. We hope to see you another time.
manage.refund: Your deposit of {amount} is being refunded.
manage.noRefund: Free cancellation ends {hours} before the booking, so the deposit is kept.
manage.locked: Online changes close {hours} before the booking — please call the house.
manage.partyFixed: The number of guests is tied to the deposit you paid; to change it, please call the house.
manage.partyLimit: For more than {n} guests, please make a new booking — larger parties need a deposit.
manage.closedStatus: This booking can no longer be changed online.
manage.unchanged: Choose a different day or time first.
manage.refundWill: Your deposit of {amount} will be refunded in full.

errors.unavailable: That time is no longer free. Please choose another.
errors.holdExpired: The hold has ended. Please choose the time again.
errors.tooLarge: For more than {n} guests, please ask about private dining.
errors.closed: The house is closed that day.
errors.taken: That table was just taken. Please choose another time.
errors.unchanged: Choose a different day or time first.

questions.seating: Where would you like to sit?

offer.title: A table has opened for you
offer.body: We are holding it in your name until {time}. Check the details and confirm.
offer.expired: This offer has ended, or the table has been taken. You can still look for another time.
offer.booked: You have already confirmed this booking.

light.dawn: At first light, while the plaster is still cool.
light.morning: In the morning shade, along the east wall.
light.noon: In the short shade, under the vine.
light.afternoon: In the long shade, as it stretches across the floor.
light.dusk: At maghrib, as the lamps are lit.
light.night: By lamplight, under an open sky.

sheet.error: The booking book could not open here.

paused: Online booking is paused for now. Please call the house — we will gladly find you a table.
